text:
alex_cs: Heads up — Epsilon Health onboarding showing sustained p95 latency + token cost creep (~18% month over month). Renewal signal in ~9w, wanted to surface a low-risk optimization plan for CS/ENG/SE alignment.

maria_eng: Thanks Alex. Do we have traffic shape? seq len, burst windows?

alex_cs: Main traffic is chat completions, avg seq ~220, big tail at 1% >1024. Peak windows 12:00–14:00 PST.

jordan_se: Quick ideas: 1) try int8 quantized variant for non-critical routes; 2) prefix/KV cache for repeated system prompts; 3) split routing by latency tier (fast path -> smaller model).

maria_eng: Agreed. Recommend canary config:```
canary:
  percent: 7
  model: rwd-open-7b-int8
  fallback_model: rwd-open-7b-fp16
  eval_prompts: small_set_customer_sensitive
  window: 48h
```

sam_ops: +1. If canary looks stable, we can schedule dedicated routing for peak hours to keep p95 SLA. Also we should prewarm KV cache before peaks.

tina_product: For renewal narrative, want before/after token-cost delta and user impact tests. Can we capture a short eval showing parity for top-10 intents?

maria_eng: I'll run a 48h A/B with those top-10 intents and capture quality metrics (bleu-ish, hallucination flags, latency). Will also log token-count distribution.

jordan_se: Also propose a temporary routing rule: if request.tokens > 700 -> route to high-capacity fp16; else -> canary int8. Simple rule reduces tail cost.

alex_cs: Good call. Let's keep rule conservative for first week. Can we implement as a per-customer route override?

sam_ops: Yep; can add a route in console: customer_id = eps123 -> priority_policy: {peak_hours: dedicated_fp16, default: canary_int8}. I can PR infra change and a staged rollout.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Created rollout ticket #RWD-4772 for route override + canary. CI checks queued.

tina_product: Action items for renewal deck: baseline cost, canary cost delta after 48h, latency p95 chart, QA summary, recommended SLA addendum.

maria_eng: Will attach eval artifacts and config snippet.

jordan_se: Suggest adding prompt-level cache TTL 30s for chat reconnects; reduces duplicate tokens during reconnect storms.

alex_cs: Assigning tasks: @maria_eng run A/B & upload eval (due +3 days), @sam_ops schedule route rollout + infra PR (due +5 days), @jordan_se implement prompt cache tweak and share metrics (due +2 days), @tina_product draft renewal slide (due +7 days).

tina_product: noted. I'll also request a short customer-facing note highlighting performance improvements post-rollout.

sam_ops: I'll coordinate a maintenance window if needed but aiming for no downtime.

alex_cs: Thanks team — let's reconvene in this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
